claims: As of April 2026, Scottie Scheffler has won four major championships.
Scottie Scheffler won the 2022 Masters Tournament by three strokes over Rory McIlroy.
Scottie Scheffler won the 2024 Masters Tournament by four strokes over Ludvig Åberg.
Scottie Scheffler won the 2025 PGA Championship.
The 2025 PGA Championship was Scottie Scheffler's third major title.
Scottie Scheffler won the 2025 Open Championship at Royal Portrush.
Scottie Scheffler needs the U.S. Open to complete the career Grand Slam.
Scottie Scheffler has won 15 times on tour.
Scottie Scheffler captured three majors before age 29.
Scottie Scheffler won the 2023 THE PLAYERS Championship.
